description.value: Gravity Haus Revelstoke is a boutique adventure-lifestyle hotel positioned as a basecamp for skiers, riders, and outdoor explorers in Revelstoke, surrounded by the Selkirk and Monashee ranges. Formerly a Motel 6 and later known as Gateway Inn, it has been reimagined as part of a North American network of mountain-town hospitality properties. On-site amenities include hot tubs, the Lüft après bar, gear rentals, and access to nearby trails and bike paths.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for gravityhaus.com/locations/revelstoke is fully available and confirms the property is an active boutique adventure hotel at 1500 1 St W Revelstoke. The website lists 'Speedy WIFI' explicitly as included in all rooms, and the Lüft bar/après space confirms on-site evening food. However, the Bike Butlers FAQ explicitly lists only Breckenridge, Vail, Steamboat, and Jackson Hole for bike services — Revelstoke is not included — and there is no mention of secure bike storage, bike wash, tools, or e-bike charging for the Revelstoke location specifically.
concerns: Website decorative coordinates display '111.4103° W 45.2778° N' which do not correspond to Revelstoke (~51°N, 118°W) — appears to be a template or copy error on the website.
OSM lists no phone number; phone sourced from website only (P: 236.577.2018).

OSM note indicates property was originally Motel 6, later Gateway Inn — verify that the Gravity Haus rebrand is current and not a recently failed venture (website is active and booking-enabled, so no immediate concern).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable accommodation in Revelstoke confirmed by a fully functional website with room listings and contact details.
enrichment_extras.notes: Gear Rentals listed as a Haus Perk but the Bike Butlers FAQ explicitly names only Breckenridge, Vail, Steamboat, and Jackson Hole for bike services in 2025 — Revelstoke is not included. Bike-specific amenities (storage, wash, tools) are not mentioned for this location.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Lüft bar listed as a Haus Perk for après; website mentions 'Aprés at Lüft'
